misconceptions.description: Treating any computer program as AI.
misconceptions.trigger: learner calls a calculator or spreadsheet formula AI
misconceptions.feedback: Ask whether the system learned from data. Programs that only follow hand-written rules are not what we mean by AI here.

misconceptions.trigger: learner cannot name AI in search, cameras or recommendations
misconceptions.feedback: Most AI is built into everyday tools: spam filters, recommendations, autocomplete, face unlock. Chatbots are one visible example.
